comment: zsh word-split: commands the Bash tool's zsh runs without splitting an unquoted $var (must deny, naming the rule and the variable) and look-alikes that split or mean one word (must allow). Replays are verbatim Bash tool commands from the transcripts.

deny.name: 2026-10-24 replay: lane checks for 503, 504 and 415 never ran
deny.command: set -o pipefail; P=/private/tmp/claude-501/-home-app/32d15c03-0292-4696-8d98-62c1fd05d847/scratchpad; W={home}/app/.claude/worktrees; I=$W/integrate-queue-347; for pair in "503-release-gap agent-a8306cae08367feb3" "504-shd-step-chain agent-a5c524b301574b2d8" "415-cleanup agent-abfbee54311257170"; do set -- $pair; ( cd $W/$2 && APP_LANE_CAP=6 tools/lane check $1 > $P/chk-$1.log 2>&1 ) & done; wait; for id in 503-release-gap 504-shd-step-chain 415-cleanup; do echo "== $id: $(tail -1 $P/chk-$id.log)"; done; cd $I && for id in 503-release-gap 504-shd-step-chain 415-cleanup; do if grep -q 'Receipt green' $P/chk-$id.log; then APP_LANE_CAP=6 tools/lane land $id 2>&1 | grep -E 'Landed|refused|done' | tail -2; fi; done
